=== S3 convergent-pinelike-lunamoth COMPLETE — all three tasks landed on main ===

LANDED, each with LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1, submitted individually per the AGENTS.md no-feature-branch fallback:
- bd6a0f0bc7 / Gerrit 1900 PS2 — T1 polarized-servile-jenny: binding_recovery.py (411 LOC) as the third internal owner; create recovery moved untouched, retirement classifier and completion added.
- f69125c5e8 / Gerrit 1903 PS2 — T2 flamboyant-possessive-blackbuck: the guarded invocation at the validated write boundary; 4 lines in the spine.
- 0b851c8103 / Gerrit 1906 PS3 — T3 likeminded-wearproof-barracuda: rich-emission cut to the facade, ADR 0099 finalized 294 -> 458 lines.

THE STORY'S PLAN WAS WRONG ABOUT WHERE THE INVOCATION GOES, and correcting it was the single most consequential act of this slice. Both this story and T2 named run_differs.py, and the epic's constraint list asked for recovery "after configuration snapshot/preflight ... but before remote issue fetch". Verified against the spine: reconcile._load_snapshots constructs the store, runs the under-lock staleness gate and performs the FIRST remote fetch all inside one call, while bind_operation_runtime and run_differs() both run after it returns. So no position in run_differs.py can precede remote observation, and the requested conjunction describes an EMPTY window. Since completion reads only local binding state, the snapshot conjunct was dropped and the pre-observation half kept — that half is load-bearing, because its purpose is to stop a pass interleaving fresh liveness evidence with completing a retirement. Corrected the story plan and file_impact FIRST, then earned the attestation (PASS, 0 blocking), then claimed. The coordinator independently verified every element. Consequence: the binding constraint was never run_differs.py's 61 lines, it was reconcile.py's FIVE (795/800), and the file is now 799.

SEVEN FALSE DOCUMENTED CLAIMS CORRECTED IN THIS SLICE ALONE, bringing the epic's total to nine. (1) binding_lifecycle said recovery "stays with BindingStore". (2) The dc-live-oracle label-writer census named binding_store.py as the third writer of the colon-form label — it greps SOURCE TEXT keyed on FILE NAME, so the T1 move broke it; retargeted after verifying exactly three production writers remain. (3) apply_handlers justified mutation-through-query with "binding_store.py sits at the module-size cap and cannot carry a narrower accessor" — the accessor exists and the file is 567 lines. (4) all_bindings() described itself as a write seam because "the baseline advance and the rich-text handler mutate an entry they got from here"; my own cut staled the second half, and the FIRST half was never true, since set_baseline reaches the repository's dictionaries directly. (5) note_rich_emit claimed a 0 return "would trigger the caller's read-back" — the threshold is an equality at 2, so it would not; the None is still right but the hazard is LATENT, and the wording now says so. (6) and (7) ADR 0099 section 9 both bullets: it said cutting the lifecycle config reads to a seam was "still not RP-02's work" and that two legacy-exception rows had been re-registered, but RP-04 C3g has since made that cut, _env_int is gone from src/ entirely, and the registry is drained to EMPTY.

TWO BEHAVIOURS PINNED AS THEY ACTUALLY ARE rather than as the AC implied. A corrupt LIVE store cannot produce a typed safety abort: it fails CLOSED in the repository loader, so construction raises and repair is unreachable — the reachable corrupt-live case is a malformed entry SHAPE, which parses and does reach the classifier. A corrupt RETIRED file fails OPEN, making tombstones invisible and yielding no candidate, so the consequence is a missed repair rather than a guessed deletion. Both are recorded in ADR 0099 section 5.

HELD-OUT TDD HELD THROUGHOUT: 42 + 21 + 36 oracles across the three tasks, with 26, 11 and 2 discriminators held outside the worktree. ALL 39 passed unseen. Each RED was authored against a signature-only scaffold so the failure was behavioural, never a bare ImportError.

MUTATION FOUND ONE REAL ORACLE GAP AND ONE EQUIVALENT MUTANT. The gap was the fourth of this epic and the same shape as S2 T1's: replacing the targeted reverse pop with a SWEEP keyed on local_id stayed GREEN across all 41 T1 tests, because every fixture had exactly one reverse key per local id. Closed with an out-of-band reverse orphan the forward entry never named. The equivalent mutant was coercing the missing binding's None to 0 — unobservable at a threshold of 2, so no test was manufactured for it, the same judgement S2 T2 applied to the unobservable env clamp. T2's most valuable kill was relocating the invocation to AFTER the first remote fetch: caught by two tests, which is exactly the defect that would leave the repair working, still tested, and silently wrong.

THREE TEST DEFECTS OF MINE, all reported by implementers who refused to work around them. The worst was T2's ordering spy loading binding_recovery.py under a fresh module name, building a DIFFERENT BindingRecovery class, so it patched a class nothing calls — the repair ran, no event was recorded, and the ordering assertion was UNFALSIFIABLE. The same file already carried a docstring warning about that exact hazard for the mode enum, and I reproduced it one fixture lower down. The other two were pre-existing binding-store doubles needing the new method.

ON THE COORDINATOR'S ADVICE the absence-only structural test became a POSITIVE plus negative anchor: it now asserts the call IS present in reconcile.py, with a docstring telling whoever extracts that capped file what must be preserved. RP-03 S5 is queued against reconcile.py, so this is filed as insectile-modest-martin (d7b9-ac42-ad6f-4608) with the invariant, the oracle that proves it, and the instruction not to relax the assertion when re-anchoring.

DEFECT FILED: easygoing-tremendous-frogmouth (7851-e06b-9e85-4c9e) — preview and dry-run passes perform remote add_label/set_entity_property writes during create recovery, because that call's only guard is `if not scoped_ids` and it receives the real configured transport, while the invariant-filing gate immediately beside it composes both axes. This story pins that gate unchanged (T1 AC6) rather than fixing it.

GATES: 3455 passed / 9 skipped across the reconciler unit tree, interfaces/store, reconciler integration and the repo-wide doc/hygiene guards; 11728 passed / 53 skipped across the whole tests/unit tree. lint, mypy 567 files, complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0, comment hygiene, config ownership, verify-gate parity and env registry all green at every push. rebar review-code still cannot preview locally (verify.enable_code_review is off and there is no env override), so the explicit five-slot surface-parity census in each commit message remains the mitigation.
